text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After a quick breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work from home, so I take short breaks between tasks to stay focused. In the afternoon, I exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or doing yoga. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, and read a book before bed. I believe consistency is the key to a healthy and balanced life.
